title: PCLink v1 PC pairing record (pairs.json)

peerName.$comment: 1-64 UTF-8 bytes, NFC, no C0/C1/Cf (e.g. U+202E). JSON Schema counts code points; implementations MUST also enforce the 64-byte UTF-8 limit and reject non-NFC.

approvedAt.$comment: PC records only; paired with approvedVia.

approvedVia.$comment: PC records only. v1.6 writes qr|manual (the verified one-time screen secret mode); cli|webui are legacy pre-v1.6 values accepted on load and never rewritten.

$comment: Every pairs.json record MUST carry approvedAt+approvedVia. v1.6 writes approvedVia qr|manual after the verified pair.auth; legacy cli|webui records remain usable. The phone record is phone-pairing-record.schema.json.
